s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive vision decline with a posterior segment mass
salient_findings: Declining vision in the left eye
Nasal mass posterior to the lens in the left eye
Large white mass protruding into the vitreous cavity
key_facts: Monitored for a left ciliary body mass for 3 years
Best-corrected visual acuity was 20/20 OD and 20/50 OS
Pupils, intraocular pressures, anterior chambers, and lenses were unremarkable in both eyes
Nasal mass posterior to the lens was evident in the left eye
Mass had grown considerably in size since the last visit
Vitreous aspirate cytology was negative for malignant cells
Microscopic findings showed a hypovascular myxoid lesion
Immunohistochemical studies showed positive S100 and patchy positive glial fibrillary acidic protein

shortlist.label: Medulloepithelioma
shortlist.why_kept: Posterior segment mass with growth and decline in vision

shortlist.label: Neurofibroma
shortlist.why_kept: Positive S100 staining and spindle cell morphology

shortlist.label: Schwannoma
shortlist.why_kept: Positive S100 staining and myxoid stroma

shortlist.label: Myxoma
shortlist.why_kept: Hypovascular myxoid lesion with positive S100 staining

shortlist.label: Glial choristoma
shortlist.why_kept: Patchy positive glial fibrillary acidic protein staining and spindle cell morphology

raw.rationale: The presence of a ciliary body mass, growth over time, and specific histopathological features such as a hypovascular myxoid lesion with spindle and stellate cells, along with positive S100 and patchy positive glial fibrillary acidic protein, are more indicative of medulloepithelioma, a rare tumor originating from the inner layer of the optic cup.

rejected.label: Neurofibroma
rejected.why: Lack of specific markers and less typical location for neurofibroma

rejected.label: Schwannoma
rejected.why: Typically shows stronger S100 positivity and different cellular arrangement

rejected.label: Myxoma
rejected.why: While myxoid features are present, the specific markers and location are less typical for myxoma

rejected.label: Glial choristoma
rejected.why: Less likely given the specific growth pattern and immunohistochemical profile
